acceptances.justification: The pinned Debian 13.6 DHI runtime has no vendor fix or verified VEX for this finding.
acceptances.impact: A successful non-blocking gzwrite exploit could corrupt the isolated task process heap and affect its integrity or availability.
acceptances.exploitability: No application call to gzwrite, gzprintf, or gzvprintf was found; the task has zero ingress and runs non-root with a read-only root filesystem.
acceptances.evidence: PR #353 CI run 34676207732 on 2026-09-12 has the same 155 software package names, versions and identifiers as PR #343 CI run 34362161480. Verified DHI VEX retains all previous statements and adds 11 not_affected statements unrelated to zlib. Residual High/Critical findings remain only zlib1g and zlib1g-dev CVE-2026-85091, version 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+dhi2, not-fixed; fixable High/Critical is zero. No application gzwrite/gzprintf/gzvprintf calls or runtime exposure changes were introduced. Replace the oldest non-current digest within the four-digest limit, retaining the deployed production digest and original expiry.
acceptances.reevaluation_conditions: Reevaluate when DHI publishes a new runtime digest, Debian publishes a fixed zlib package, verified VEX changes, or task exposure changes.
